messages:
Jamie: Anyone know where to find traces for batch-processor-4? Seeing top-level request spans but child spans (prefetcher/kvcache) are gone in recent traces. Window: 12:05-12:12 UTC. Any dashboards or quick checks? :eyes:

Ola: Which region? We had a collector tweak last night.

Jamie: prod-us-west — job id job-88432. Logs show a bunch of `kvcache miss` and then early returns.

Devon: Try Tempo traces: https://tempo.redwood.internal/d/traces?query=service=batch-processor-4
Also logs: https://logs.redwood.com/prod-us-west?query=job-88432

Arjun: Quick checklist:
1) Confirm OTEL SDK version in the container
2) Check collector tail-sampling config — we accidentally tightened it earlier
3) Look for attribute-based span queries (component=prefetcher)

Arjun: Example grep in logs:
```
kubectl logs -n infra batch-processor-4-abc --since=20m | grep kvcache
```

Priya: FYI I pushed a tail-sampling change to the collector to reduce noise — target 5% for batch-* services. Maybe that's the culprit. Link to dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/obs/collector-sampling?orgId=1

deploy-bot: Deploy: infra/collector v2.4.1 rolled to prod-us-west at 2026-03-16T23:58:12Z

Jamie: That would explain it. How can we get a quick rollback or exception for batch-processor-4? Need traces for a debugging window.

Olga: I can temporarily exempt batch-processor-* from aggressive tail-sampling for 6h. Filing an alert-tuning ticket: INF-4321. Reverting now.

Priya: I'll open a PR to set tail-sampler rate to 50% for services matching `batch-processor.*` and request @olga review.

Devon: Also check whether the app is emitting child spans at all — if prefetcher returns early it might skip creating spans. Search for `span.create` logs in debug mode.

Jamie: Good point — I can enable DEBUG for 10m and re-run the failing job.

Arjun: For trace queries in Tempo use this attribute filter: `service=batch-processor-4 AND span.attributes.component=prefetcher`

Jamie: Thanks all — will retest after the revert. Please ping here when INF-4321 is updated. :thumbsup:

Olga: PR merged, sampling override applied, will monitor. Posting before/after graphs in 5m.

Priya: Ticket INF-4321 updated with links and rollback notes.

Jamie: I see child spans back in traces now. Closing the loop — thanks! :tada:
